“嫂子，你这是？”

李青山望着柳桂香身上的猎弓，脸上闪过一抹诧异道。

“你不是要上山去打猎吗？”

“手里没有趁手的家伙怎么能行，我回了一趟娘家，将我爹的这把弓给你取了回来，反正他现在也用不上！”

说罢。

柳桂香便将手中的猎弓给李青山递了过去，继续道：“我哥还在外面等着，是他送我回来的，我去和他说一声好让他回去。”

接过柳桂香手中的猎弓，李青山心中一暖。

一把猎弓的价格可是不便宜。

大概在五块钱到二十块钱之间，柳桂香给自己的这把弓看品相，八九块钱肯定要的。

可莫要小看了这八九块钱。

这个年代，农村一家子一年到头除去吃喝，是几乎攒不下来钱的，得省吃俭用，方能积攒下来一些。

野鸡才三毛多钱一只。

九块钱，至少能买二十多只野鸡解馋了。

粮食金贵的年代，就更别提野鸡肉了，那都是逢年过节都不一定能吃上的好东西。

可以说。

当初老李家给柳桂香嫂子的彩礼，都没有十块钱。

“嫂子，你爹是怎么同意的？”李青山望着手中的猎弓，有些感动道。

嫂子的父亲，不可能无缘无故让她将猎弓带回婆家。

毕竟，嫁出去的闺女，泼出去的水。

“你别管了，带着弓上山吧，一切注意安全就是了。”柳桂香开口催促道。

李青山的目光朝着柳桂香身上打量着，很快便发现柳桂香身上少了一件东西。

银手镯。

那是嫂子嫁过来时候带的嫁妆，昨天晚上还在，现在就没了，李青山一切都明白了。

是嫂子用嫁妆，将这弓换了回来。

唉！！

此刻，李青山感觉自己手中的这把弓，有些沉甸甸的。

等到以后赚到钱了，得想办法给嫂子将嫁妆给置办回来。

一个女人，给自己男人用嫁妆的都不多，更何况，自己还只是嫂子的小叔子，这份恩情，李青山是记下了。

“嫂子，你这赶了一晚上的路，恐怕累的够呛，你快回房间里休息吧，我去和大哥说一声。”

李青山关心道。

“好！”

柳桂香点了点头，朝着房间内走了进去，李青山望着柳桂香的步子眉头一拧，便朝着门外走去。

老李家的家风就是，吸老三的血。

喂养老大。

嫂子也是三房的，自然也是在吸血的范围内，这些年没少填补，这也就导致嫂子的娘家人十分不爽，甚至起过几次冲突。

最后。

嫂子的娘家人发誓，以后绝对不踏入老李家半步。

“大哥，给你们添麻烦了。”

李青山见外面站着的是柳桂香的大哥柳大柱，便走上前去打招呼道。

“嗯！”

"Sister-in-law, what are you doing?"

Li Qingshan looked at the hunting bow on Liu Guixiang's body, and a flash of surprise flashed across his face.

"Aren't you going to go hunting in the mountains?"

"How can you do it without someone who can take advantage of it? I went back to my parents' house and got my father's bow back for you. He doesn't need it now anyway!"

Say it.

Liu Guixiang handed the hunting bow in her hand to Li Qingshan and continued: "My brother is still waiting outside. He sent me back. I will go and tell him so that he can go back."

Li Qingshan felt warm in his heart after taking the hunting bow from Liu Guixiang.

The price of a hunting bow is not cheap.

It's probably between five and twenty yuan. Liu Guixiang gave her a bow, and judging from its condition, she would definitely pay eight or nine yuan for it.

But don’t underestimate these eight or nine dollars.

In this era, a rural family can hardly save any money except for eating and drinking all year round. They have to save money in order to save some money.

A pheasant costs just over thirty cents.

For nine yuan, you can buy at least twenty pheasants to satisfy your craving.

In an era when food was expensive, let alone pheasant meat, they were all good things that you might not be able to eat during the holidays.

It can be said.

The betrothal gift given by the old Li family to Liu Guixiang's sister-in-law was only ten yuan.

"Sister-in-law, why did your father agree?" Li Qingshan looked at the hunting bow in his hand and asked with some emotion.

It is impossible for my sister-in-law's father to let her take the hunting bow back to her husband's house for no reason.

After all, the daughter who gets married is the water she throws away.

"Don't worry about it. Just take your bow and go up the mountain. Just pay attention to safety." Liu Guixiang urged.

Li Qingshan looked at Liu Guixiang and soon discovered that something was missing from Liu Guixiang.

Silver bracelet.

It was the dowry that my sister-in-law brought when she got married. It was there last night, but it is gone now. Li Qingshan understood everything.

It was my sister-in-law who used her dowry to buy this bow back.

well!!

At this moment, Li Qingshan felt that the bow in his hand was a little heavy.

When I make money in the future, I have to find a way to buy the dowry for my sister-in-law.

A woman doesn't have much dowry for her man, not to mention that she is only his sister-in-law's brother-in-law. Li Qingshan has remembered this kindness.

"Sister-in-law, I'm afraid you're exhausted after traveling all night. You should go back to your room and rest. I'll go talk to my eldest brother."

Li Qingshan expressed concern.

"Okay!"

Liu Guixiang nodded and walked into the room. Li Qingshan frowned at Liu Guixiang's steps and walked out the door.

The family tradition of Lao Li's family is to suck the blood of the third child.

Feed the boss.

My sister-in-law is also a third-wife, so she is naturally within the scope of blood-sucking. She has been filling in the gap over the years, which has caused my sister-in-law's family to be very unhappy and even had several conflicts.

at last.

My sister-in-law's mother-in-law's family swore that they would never set foot in Lao Li's house in the future.

"Brother, I'm causing trouble for you."

Li Qingshan saw Liu Guixiang's eldest brother Liu Dazhu standing outside, so he walked up to say hello.

"Yeah!"
